_: Planted red/green controls for the CLI wiring (main/exit), which every other test in the suite never reaches — they exercise analyzeTitle()/extractAddedTitles() directly or drive collectOffenders via a synthetic diff string, never the spawned process. The `-always-passes`/`-always-blocks` pair grades every SPAWNED test across both suites (the offender branch is shared by every call path). The two `-diff-args-dropped` entries pin that each call site actually threads the whole DIFF_ARGS array through, regardless of what DIFF_ARGS itself contains — a single flag's own presence inside the array is pinned separately, at diff-parse.mjs's own suite (.claude/hooks/diff-parse.mutations.json).
